definition: Original architecture: learned mask tokens, content gate, structural gate, Transformer blocks, and structured modality dropout.
Replace missing-modality mask-token vectors with zero vectors; all other components retained.
Remove the content-derived gate branch; retain the availability/structural gate branch.
Remove the availability/structural gate branch; retain the content-derived gate branch.
Remove both learned gate branches and assign equal weights across modalities available for each participant. This is the operational No-Both-Gates condition; it is not a separate eighth model.
Bypass the cross-modal Transformer blocks and CLS aggregation; classify the availability-weighted modality-token summary.
Disable structured modality dropout during training; retain inference-time availability masks, Transformer, and both learned gate branches.
